name: Retributive Strike
trigger: An enemy damages your ally, and both are in your champion’s aura
effect_html: You protect your ally and strike your enemy. The ally gains resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to 2 + your level. If the enemy is within reach, make a melee Strike against it.
